The dataset records physical waste-composition sampling from university dormitories. Its stated coverage is Czech Republic; three consecutive academic years. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata and lists XLSX resources; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is CC BY 4.0. Student accommodation is not representative of all municipal waste generators. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
